g.title: HR_JOBGRIDCOMPGAP
g.text: Job Grid expected competency proficiency - This entity enables a user to set a gap value from the expected proficiency for the competencies associated to the job grid. The value zero (0) indicates it is the expected proficiency.
Identifies the record intersecting a competency in a job grid and a value of the reading scale.
Indicates the date and time of creation
Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_JOBGRIDCOMP
g.text: Job Grid Competency - This entity collects the grid competencies associated to a job.

Indicates the user who has created it
Indicates the IP address from which it was created
Indicates the date and time of last update operation
Indicates the user who has executed last update
Indicates the IP address from which was executed last update
Indicates how many update was executed since its creation

g.title: HR_COMPGRIDROWSCORE
g.text: Competency Grid Row Score - This entity allows setting a score for competencies within the grid.
